delivery_note: Alex, upbeat and clear, a wry storyteller who knows the ending: brisk through the rain and the theft, drier on the box and the last line.

narration.text: [energetic] In 2019, a top-performing analyst named Maya got escorted out of her building by security. [knowing] The whole disaster started because she held the office door for two seconds.

[upbeat] It was a pouring Monday morning. Maya tapped her keycard, and a sharp-dressed guy juggling two hot coffees sprinted up behind her yelling, "Hold on, thanks!" [amused] Being polite, Maya flashed a smile and held the office door.
[suspicious] Only problem? He didn't work there—not even close. While Maya waited for the elevator,
[fast-paced] he strolled past three cubicles and slid an unlocked laptop into his leather bag. [deadpan] He even waved at the front desk walking out. Nobody glanced up.
[dramatic] Turns out that single laptop held private financial records for two hundred major clients. Before dinner, every file was up for auction
[fast-paced] online—and fraud investigators were tearing the entire office apart. [serious] Security pulled one ten-second lobby clip,
[serious] and Maya's career vanished before Friday. No second chance, no severance—just a cardboard box. [deadpan] She'd literally just held the office door.
[ironic] Even today, every single new hire watches her ten-second clip on orientation morning.

music.prompt: Instrumental, no vocals, no drums. Restrained modern underscore for a wry cautionary office tale. Starts almost bare: a soft low pad and a faint ticking muted pluck. Turns on a small minor-key shift with a light pulsing synth and ticking motif as the story turns, stays tense and quiet through a dark middle with only a low pad, then resolves softly and dry into a single held warm chord at the very end. Thin and sparse, never loud, leaves room for a narrator.

Large stone office lobby room tone with soft echo, a faint air-conditioning hum and distant muffled rain behind glass. No voices, no music. Seamless loop.
Open-plan office room tone, soft keyboard clicks, a distant printer, quiet air-conditioning hum, no speech. Seamless loop.
Dim quiet room at night, low laptop fan, faint router tick, very distant traffic, tense and still. No voices, no music. Seamless loop.
Bright quiet meeting room tone, soft air-conditioning hum, a faint chair creak now and then, no speech. Seamless loop.
